name: safe-edit-skill
description: Safe, format-preserving text edits through a structured MCP transport and CLI fallback.

interface.longDescription: Inspect encodings and line endings, then apply guarded multi-file edits through a persistent structured MCP service for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and VS Code.
defaultPrompt: Safely update these files without changing their encoding or line endings.
Inspect these files and apply the edits as one guarded transaction.
